channel.title: Big Night of Musicals by the National Lottery
channel.desc: Jason Manford hosts a joyful celebration of musical theatre, with show-stopping performances and special guests from across the West End and the UK's leading touring productions. In a world first, Sam Ryder delivers an incredible performance of Gethsemane (I Only Want to Say) from Jesus Christ Superstar ahead of his debut in the show this summer.
